description:
Implement the specialized Gray square-QAM demapper that exploits axis separability and other square-QAM structure while preserving the shared API.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] The specialized demapper supports the built-in Gray QAM presets required by the epic.
- [ ] The fast path is API-compatible with the generic modem reference path.
- [ ] Outputs match the reference demapper across representative AWGN test cases.

## Notes

This task should focus on algorithmic structure first and leave backend-specific acceleration hooks to the follow-on batch-kernel task.
title: Implement fast Gray square-QAM soft demapper
